status: Historical verified backend/transport prerequisite; live producer progress and current remaining work are qualified separately
shared_policy: Store::native_language_command_inner owns claim, original outcome publication, positive cleanup and settlement. Both native endpoint adapters call it.
WorkspaceJournalResponse::command_worker validates mutation acknowledgements in both native HTTP clients.
One pending-command SQL predicate includes native_settlement_pending across activity, admission, pruning and project deletion.
adapters: BackendClient::workspace_journal_service uses the authenticated command service for mutations.
PairedCommandJournal translates the shared journal primitives to a command-purpose bootstrap plus native worker preimage; no deployment-wide service secret is sent.
verified_behavior: A command claim survives terminal file recovery and file-worker release. Admitted command credentials do not expire by age.
Start requires original committed file/edit state and fresh manual authority; recovery does not authorize a new dispatch.
Native outcomes are immutable. Identical retries can monotonically add positive cleanup. Browser Finish can join an identical result but cannot replace an owned native result.
Uncertain/rejected outcomes require positive cleanup and manual acknowledgement before terminal settlement. Backend activity, retention and project deletion remain protected until settlement.
Original callbacks work from compact metadata with unreadable approval/source/outcome payloads. New producer admission still validates the original readable approval and installed provider.
Actual schema69 upgrade and replay preserve immutable metadata and admitted credentials, including completed-but-unsettled commands with unreadable archived payloads.
File and command grants cannot substitute for each other. Released command credentials cannot inspect; duplicate final acknowledgements disclose only compact metadata.

Both native mutation transports reject wrong original generation/root/invocation/worker, changed outcome fingerprints, regressed revisions, missing or inconsistent cleanup/settlement and malformed or oversized replies.
Both HTTP adapters transmit a valid outcome larger than64KiB while keeping replies bounded to64KiB. Paired requests do not inherit cookie, origin or deployment authorization headers.

bounds.admitted_grant_lifetime: Bound to original ownership, not elapsed time
